title: devbin dogfood's own expiry has passed: delegate to intent init or delete it
body:
`bin/devbin dogfood`'s header sets its own expiry: "When `intent init` is wired, this command delegates to it or is deleted". The same header says init is wired, so the condition has been met and the command still hand-writes the one file init owns. Its printed text was corrected at edcb5a501 to say it is due; the decision whether to delegate or delete is still open.

XS either way. Found in dc's doc sweep of 2026-09-18.


CLOSED 2026-09-19, by its landing in dc's train C on vc's word (bank 486f02f17, patch-id 115c30b106a6, judged green on the train's bats log refs/bank/dc/trainC/bats.log: every arm green on the fixed script and the new arm red on the unfixed one).
